scale: 1-5; 2 and 4 sit between the written anchors
title: Channel dossier (research on an existing channel)

anchors.3: Most numbers sourced; some methods missing.
anchors.5: Every number traceable to a pull file or a dated URL with its method.
Outliers and medians examined with measured hook, cuts and pacing.

anchors.1: A list of facts with no 'so what'.
anchors.5: Explains why it works (what drives outliers) in a way a planner can act on.

anchors.3: Estimates with method, missing ranges or sources.
anchors.5: Every stream evidenced; estimates as ranges with method and tags.
Complete 'could not examine' with blocked URLs and what would close each gap.

vetoes: fabrication: an invented number, quote or source
